## What changes

<!-- One or two sentences. What does a user or a contributor get? -->

## How you checked it

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes.
- [ ] A change to `src/render`, `src/api` or a shader: `pnpm check:render` passes on your machine. CI has no GPU.
- [ ] A change that can cost or save time: the numbers of `pnpm bench:ab`, with the machine.

## Changeset

- [ ] A change to the published package brings a changeset: `pnpm changeset`.
- [ ] Or the change needs no release, and the label `skip-changeset` says so.
